---
title: "Chart context"
---

```{python}
import duckdb
from IPython.display import display

con = duckdb.connect("../data/processed/music_life.duckdb", read_only=True)
week = con.execute("""
SELECT ce.position, ce.artist_name, ce.title, r.spotify_url
FROM chart_entries ce
JOIN charts c USING (chart_id)
LEFT JOIN recordings r ON ce.recording_id=r.recording_id
WHERE c.name='Billboard Hot 100'
  AND ce.chart_date=DATE '1978-06-24'
ORDER BY ce.position
""").df()
display(week)
```

Production ingestion should retain the **complete weekly chart**, enabling:

- overlap with a focus single's entire run;
- songs immediately above/below it;
- artists dominating the same period;
- biggest climbers/fallers;
- US versus UK context;
- Spotify links for confidently matched historical chart recordings.

The displayed rows are demo data until a source-backed chart adapter is enabled.
